name: FetchEmailAttachments
description: Code, not an agent: stores every attachment of one inbound email that arrives with a downloadable url (no mail provider is connected; Gmail was removed 10.11, Outlook later — an attachment without a url is kept as ממתין and skipped), stores the file and writes one EmailAttachments row per file (unique messageId + fileName, idempotent). Extraction: PDF with a text layer → text (unpdf); Excel / CSV → each sheet as tab-separated text (xlsx); image or scanned PDF → extractionState דורש OCR (read by file name only); anything else → לא נתמך. A failed file is marked נכשל with the error and never stops the email. Then builds promptForAgent: the full Hebrew brief Maya sorts from, in the fixed format 'משימה: מיון מייל נכנס / שולח / מה ידוע על השולח / מועמדי לקוח (קוד | שם | איך נמצא) / נושא / קבצים מצורפים / גוף', with each file's extracted text (capped per file and in total). Sends nothing.

attachments.description: Attachment metadata from the provider (filename, mimeType, attachmentId, url when available)
{ id, fileName, fileKind, extractionState, chars, error }

promptForAgent.description: The full brief for Maya's sorting call
